atomicChanges.variableName: Gross Sales definition
atomicChanges.oldValue: Gross Sales means all revenue received from the Franchised Restaurant, excluding sales tax, approved promotional giveaways and refunds; complimentary items are included unless the promotional plan is approved.
atomicChanges.newValue: Gross Sales means all revenue and other consideration generated from operating the Restaurant, with specified exclusions; all transactions must be entered at full non-discounted retail price in the Information System, and Gross Sales are not reduced by amounts paid to third-party food ordering and delivery systems.

oldEvidence.quote: Note 2 The term “Gross Sales” means all revenue received by you from the operation of the Franchised Restaurant whether from sales for cash or credit including sales of merchandise, products and services Gross Sales will not include sales tax, approved promotional giveaways and refunds

newEvidence.quote: The term “Gross Sales” means the total of all revenue and other consideration you generate from operating the Restaurant whether from sales for cash or credit, and irrespective of collection

All transactions first will be (and must be) entered into the Information System at the full (non-discounted) retail price, plus all related fees and charges, for purposes of calculating Gross Sales. For the avoidance of doubt, Gross Sales are not
reduced by the amount paid to, retained or collected by, or shared with third-party food ordering and delivery systems with which your Restaurant does business.

atomicChanges.reason: The Gross Sales denominator is substantively redefined, including mandatory full-retail-price entry and no reduction for third-party delivery fees.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not treat the old and new Gross Sales bases as the same denominator, and do not infer higher or lower percentage fees without a specific revenue scenario.

atomicChanges.variableName: Franchisor discretion to modify Gross Sales policies

atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the discretion was exercised or that any Gross Sales definition was changed after 2025.

atomicChanges.oldValue: If the franchisee defaults on the Area Development Agreement before opening the 3rd Franchised Restaurant, monthly Gross Sales will immediately revert to 7% on all existing Franchise Agreements.
atomicChanges.newValue: If the franchisee defaults under the Development Rights Agreement and does not open at least 3 Restaurants, Capriotti's has the right immediately to increase the Royalty Fee to 7% under all existing Franchise Agreements.

oldEvidence.quote: Should you default on the Area Development Agreement before opening the 3rd Franchised Restaurant, your monthly Gross Sales will immediately revert to 7% of monthly Gross Sales on all existing Franchise Agreements

newEvidence.quote: However, if you default under the Development Rights Agreement and do not open at least 3 Restaurants, we have the right immediately to increase the Royalty Fee to 7% of Gross Sales under all of your existing Franchise Agreements.

atomicChanges.reason: The default consequence changes from an automatic 7% reversion to a franchisor right to increase the royalty rate to 7%.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that any default occurred or that the right was exercised.
